1.text: Actions are according to intentions. What everyone will get is what they intend.

2.text: None of you can be a true believer unless he wants for his brother what he wants for himself.

3.text: A Muslim is someone from whose tongue and hands other Muslims are safe.

4.text: Prayer is the pillar of religion.

5.text: Whoever fasts Ramadan out of faith and expecting reward from Allah, his past sins will be forgiven.

7.text: I was sent only to complete good morals.

8.text: The best of you is the one who is best to his family.

9.text: Smiling at your brother's face is charity.

10.text: Heaven is under the feet of mothers.

12.text: You are all shepherds and you are responsible for what you herd.

13.text: Seek knowledge from the cradle to the grave.

14.text: Whoever takes a path to learn knowledge, Allah will make the path to heaven easier for him.

15.text: Prayer is the essence of worship.

16.text: Pray to Allah with confidence that it will be accepted.

18.text: How beautiful is the work of a believer. Every situation is good; If he is happy, he will be thankful, this will be good for him; If trouble happens to him, he will be patient, and this will be good for him.

19.text: Those who act economically will not become poor.

20.text: The hand that gives is better than the hand that receives.

101.text: He who believes in Allah and the Last Day should either speak good or remain silent.

102.text: There are three characteristics that give the taste of faith to whoever has them: To love Allah and His Messenger more than anything else, to love the person he loves only for the sake of Allah, to be afraid of returning to disbelief after Allah has saved him from disbelief, just as he is afraid of being thrown into the fire.

104.text: The most perfect believer in terms of faith is the one with the best morals.

105.text: Whoever among you sees evil, let him correct it with his hand. If he cannot do this, let him correct it with his tongue. If he cannot do this, let him hate it with his heart. This is the weakest degree of faith.

106.text: Kalbinde zerre kadar kibir bulunan kimse cennete giremez.

108.text: The most virtuous of deeds is to love for the sake of Allah and to hate for the sake of Allah.

109.text: Whoever dies knowing that there is no god but Allah will enter heaven.

110.text: Anyone who is pleased with Allah as Lord, Islam as religion, and Muhammad as prophet has tasted the taste of faith.

201.text: Whoever performs two coolness prayers (morning and afternoon) will enter heaven.

202.text: The five daily prayers and the Friday prayer until the next Friday are an atonement for minor sins committed between them, as long as major sins are avoided.

203.text: The moment when the servant is closest to his Lord is in prostration. So pray a lot in prostration.

204.text: Islam is founded on five pillars: testifying that there is no god but Allah and that Muhammad is the Messenger of Allah, performing prayers, giving alms, performing the pilgrimage and fasting in Ramadan.

205.text: Whoever spends the Night of Power in worship, believing in his virtue and expecting his reward from Allah, his past sins will be forgiven.

206.text: Umrah is atonement for the sins committed in between until the next Umrah. The reward for an accepted Hajj is only heaven.

207.text: Anyone who forgets to eat or drink while fasting should complete his fast. Because God gave him food and drink.

208.text: Whoever performs ablution well, his sins come out of his entire body, even under his nails.

209.text: If people knew the reward of calling the adhan and praying in the first row, and if they had no choice but to draw lots, they would definitely draw lots.

210.text: Whoever goes to the mosque morning and evening, Allah will prepare a treat for him in heaven every time he comes and goes.

301.text: A strong person is not the one who defeats his opponent in wrestling, but the one who controls himself in times of anger.

302.text: Beware of suspicion. Because assumption is the most false of words.

303.text: Do not envy each other, do not provoke each other in shopping, do not hold grudges against each other, and do not turn your back on each other.

304.text: He who believes in Allah and the Last Day should honor his guest.

305.text: Righteousness leads to goodness, and goodness leads to heaven. A person who tells the truth is written as a truthful person in the sight of Allah.

306.text: The devotion of a believer to another is like a building whose stones are interlocked.

307.text: He who does not thank people does not thank God either.

308.text: Fear Allah wherever you are. Do good immediately after evil so that it can erase it. Get along nicely with people.

310.text: Make it easy, don't make it difficult; Give good news, don't make people hate.

401.text: The consent of the Lord is in the consent of the parents. The wrath of the Lord is also in the wrath of the parents.

402.text: Anyone who wants his livelihood to be expanded and his life to be extended should take care of his relatives.

403.text: A person who cuts off ties with his relatives cannot enter heaven.

404.text: The best of you is the one who is best to his women.

405.text: He is the most perfect believer in terms of faith, the one with the best morals, and the one who treats his family most kindly.

406.text: The child's right on the father is to give him a good name and a good upbringing.

407.text: No father has left a more valuable legacy to his child than a good upbringing.

408.text: Fear Allah and be just among your children.

409.text: You and your property belong to your father.

410.text: The world is just a subsistence. The best blessing in the world is a righteous woman.

501.text: Learning knowledge is obligatory for every Muslim.

502.text: The best of you is the one who learns and teaches the Quran.

504.text: Whoever Allah wishes good for, He gives him understanding in religion.

505.text: When a person dies, his book of deeds is closed. Except for three things: Charity, useful knowledge, and a good child who prays for him.

506.text: The superiority of a scholar over a monument is like the superiority of the full moon over other stars.

507.text: Whoever causes good deeds will be rewarded as much as the person who did that good deed.

508.text: Angels spread their wings over someone who learns knowledge because they are pleased with him.

601.text: There is nothing more valuable in the sight of Allah than prayer.

602.text: Kim Allah'tan istemezse, Allah ona gazap eder.

603.text: Unless one of you rushes by saying, "I prayed but it was not accepted," his prayer will be accepted.

604.text: The prayer of a Muslim person for his religious brother in his absence is accepted.

605.text: Your Lord is modest and generous. When His servant raises his hands to Him, He is ashamed to turn them away empty.

606.text: The moment when the Lord is closest to the servant is the last half of the night. If you can be among those who remember Allah at that hour, be it.

607.text: Prayer is beneficial against the troubles that have come down and those that have not come down. O servants of Allah, hold fast to prayer.

608.text: There are three prayers that will undoubtedly be accepted: the prayer of the oppressed, the prayer of the traveler and the prayer of the father for his child.

701.text: A Muslim does not suffer from evil, illness, grief, sadness, torment or sorrow, even if a thorn stings his foot, Allah makes these atonement for his sins.

702.text: Patience is when the disaster first occurs.

703.text: Whoever tries to be patient, Allah will give him patience. No one has been given a better or more comprehensive blessing than patience.

704.text: When Allah loves a people, He tests them.

705.text: When the people of trouble are given their rewards on the Day of Judgment, those who are well in this world will hope that their skin will be cut with scissors.

706.text: Troubles never cease on the soul, children and property of the believing man and woman. Until he meets Allah without sin.

707.text: Heaven is surrounded by difficulties and hell is surrounded by lusts.

801.text: If you truly trusted in Allah, He would provide for you just as He provides for the birds. They go hungry in the morning and return full in the evening.

802.text: No one has ever eaten a meal better than the labor of his own hands.

803.text: Buyer and seller are free as long as they do not separate from each other. If they tell the truth and explain the flaws, their shopping will be fruitful.

804.text: He who is not thankful for a little will not be thankful for much.

805.text: My God. I ask you for guidance, piety, chastity and wealth of heart.

806.text: How beautiful is righteous wealth for a righteous person.

807.text: One who helps widows and the poor is like one who strives in the way of Allah.
